review:
Right across from the beach but about a 30 min walk to centro storico. Room was spacious for a  single room and bed was super comfy. Loved that there was a fitness centre and they provide beach towels (there is a cost of 3€ to rent).
Limited parking onsite - need to reserve in advance. Parking in this area can be found (there is a new lot right behind hotel, but its expensive to park overnight -around 20€)

Excellent location, 7 min walk from parking garage at Piazzale Roma, 25 minute walk to St.Mark’s Square.  Excellent breakfast with a beautiful outdoor patio. wonderful surroundings around the hotel, beautiful atmospheric historic Palazzo Hotel.  Air conditioning.  2pm checkin, 11am checkout.

This place was absolutely fantastic! Recently renovated, the accommodation was spotless, modern, and very comfortable. The location couldn’t be better—just 500 meters from the heart of downtown Verona, yet tucked away in a quieter area with fewer tourists. It offered the perfect balance of convenience and tranquility.

The hosts were incredibly welcoming and helpful, making sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay. One of the unexpected highlights was breakfast at a nearby bar. They offered a mix of continental (sandwich/pizza) and traditional Italian options (pastries and croissants), including gluten-free croissants sourced from a local boulangerie, an absolute treat for our son!

Truly a gem of a place in Verona—stylish, central, and run by people who genuinely care about your experience. Highly recommend!

I was so relieved that there was parking so close by and available!  It is difficult sometimes to find parking in these little Italian towns, but thankfully that wasn’t the case here in Tropea.  The B&B is located in a quiet part of town just off one of the main squares,  yet also so close to the shopping and Centro area, and also within 10 minutes by foot to the beaches.  I was given a lot of opportunity and received great communication throughout my booking, and ended up staying for 3 days (when I had first only booked one night!).  I slept like a baby in the comfy bed in a beautiful suite.  The breakfast was delicious and ample, and I appreciated the small fridge in my room as well as the coffee/tea maker. Plenty of good restaurants and gelaterias in the area as well.  I enjoyed my trip to Tropea because of B&B Giorgia, and will absolutely come back again!  Thank you to Michael and all staff at B&B Giorgia!
nothing.

Everything was good. Very friendly staff. Good choice of food and drinks at the bar. Excellent facilities. Not far from the central station. Good vibes.
I liked everything.

Friendly traditional authentic. Lots of local customers. Helpful. Good dinner and breakfast.
Very quiet at night.
Shower a little cramped, OK for average person.

The staff is amazing and extremely friendly and very helpful

everything was wonderful
host was great and gave us a lot of information 
everything we wanted

Deco was a bit weird for an older tourist.

The natural surrounding around the hotel was great!!! But that’s pretty much all.
They open the hotel too rush, nothing in the place! Staffs/ interiors/ devices were poorly prepared.
Location is extremely convenient of your visiting the hospital in the area; staff is super nice.
Location is like a fairytale. Breakfast and dinner is incredible. The staff were all absolutely lovely. After staying for only one night our only regret is that we didn’t have more time here.

The unit and property were quite large and secluded. It had a large patio that was overlooking a big manicured lawn with greenspace beyond.  In an area like the Amalfi Coast where everything is quite congested, it was really nice to feel secluded while at the property.  The unit itself has two very large bathrooms and two large bedrooms.  One bedroom has a door that leads directly to the back patio.  The ceilings were so tall, it made the space feel even bigger. 
Check in was fantastic.  The operator was friendly and gave recommendations for transit and restaurants throughout the Coast.  She was available by Whatsapp throughout our visit and she was always quick to reply.  
We chose Bomerano for easy access to the Path of the Gods and it worked out perfectly.  We wanted an early start to the hike and we were able to easily do that by just walking a few minutes to the start of the trail.
This rental is only a couple minutes walk to the main square of the town, along the grocery stores (although these are small and limited here- I recommend stopping outside Amalfi and bringing in your main staples), various restaurants. 
The property is gated and has parking right at the front door the unit.  The unit itself is withing a larger house, with what seemed like another unit upstairs, however no one else was there at the time, so it felt very private. 
All in all, this vacation rental fit the bill for our needs. Thanks for a great stay!
The dishes and facilities in the kitchen were a bit tired.  Some of the dishes did not seem quite squeaky clean.  It wasn't anything a quick rinse couldn't fix and its not something that would deter me from staying here again.  It was great having a washing machine on the property, but each time I tried it, the soap would not dispense.  This very well could have been user error, especially since I was using google translate to figure out the settings on the machine.

The appartment is perfect. Well located, you are in the center of Trastevere and close to most of the historic sites. 
Everything was perfect, from the comfy beds, to ac and the huge terrace. 
We’ll definately come back.

Loved the space. The bedrooms were very spacious and I loved that there were 2 bathrooms.
The neighbor across the hall was a bit grumpy.

Best hotel I have ever been to, super stylish. The staff were incredibly friendly. Breakfast was absolutely next-level, with so many options I didn’t even know where to start, and they even have a whole gluten-free section. Honestly, for breakfast they had everything you could ever dream of, really. The room was spotless, super cozy, elegantly designed with very comfortable bed. I loved all the little details that made it feel special. It had that perfect mix of comfort and style, and I absolutely loved every moment of this. If I could, I’d give it 100 stars.

Franco and his son were so helpful from checking us in, showing us our room, storing our bikes, and setting the AC.  Our room was spacious, the bed was very comfortable, the bathroom was also spacious with a big shower and great water pressure.  Big, soft towels. 
  We had one of the best sleeps on our 7 week holiday.   Breakfast was wonderful, good variety. Franco recommended a restaurant nearby, which was fabulous: food like my Italian mother in law used to make.  
We really enjoyed our stay and feel like we have a new friend in Franco.  When we come back, this is where we will stay.

Everything from location to helpfulness of staff, great spot to travel in and out of venice, grocery store right across street (Lidl), gas station as well, and real good pizzeria down the street 500yds it was a hopping little place, we had supper there 2nights, we enjoyed our stay and would return.

The room given had a small balcony which was a plus for drying clothes..Two rooms so appeared big overall..entry security procedures were good..hostel bar opposite -convenient for happy hour drinks and decent food..Cafe 1 min walk for bfast..reception staff allowed after checkout storage of bags at their reception room...small lift available in the building..fridge small but available..old stove present but we didn't use it..staff available always through wattsapp for any enquiries
The room given was not what we had booked through Booking.com...on enquiry with staff was told this is the only one available..decided to stay there rather than changing rooms the next day with all the luggage..only one AC for two rooms which took one day to bring down the temp in the room to 23 degrees with a pedestal fan provided in the second room..bathroom was small..floor cleaning was absolutely not done and my son had a dust allergy because of that...

Excellent, clean and well supplied kitchen. Great AC and TVs with streaming. Easily accessibly to old town.
Some general cooking supplies such  as pepper, salt, and oil would have been great!
Can't fault it 😊 Excellent location.  Authentic decor. Comfortable beds. Excellent service...super accommodating!.Recommend for families, couples or solo travellers.

- The balcony view was awesome. Plenty of space and and comfortable seats. 
- There was plenty of snacks
- The AC was working just fine and super well in the room
- The kitchen had everything we needed. 
- Location: We could walk to and from the Vatican (1.5km) and the colloseum (1km). Small grocery store 200m away. 
- The owner: He was there in the morning(s), answered our questions, friendly, obviously cared about his place. 
- Out of 4 places we stayed at in Italy on our trip, this was our favorite place!
- 5 level up, no elevator. But honestly, compared to the rest, it became a minor inconvenience to us. 
- The shower's water was hot and cold. It wouldn't stay hot.

We were upgraded to a balcony room with an impeccable view of the lake.  The room was clean and had a prosecco bottle and card to welcome us upon our arrival.  The only thing I remarked was the small bathroom, although, clean and equipped with plush robes.  The breakfast had a phenomenal view and many choices beautifully displayed.  The staff, Marina and Francesca, were so friendly and polite.  The pool area, bar areas, restaurants, and lobby were all maintained in pristine condition.  The location was in a charming piazza next to Villa Cipressi and Villa Monastero.  Truly a gem in magnificent Varenna.

Relatively large-size room, good location.
The room was in a basement, no view, which is slightly depressing. No breakfast. No elevator to get to the basement which could be an issue if one has large bags, especially women. Two feisty local women who run the place tried to extort a city tax every morning despite it was clearly paid through Booking.com with confirmation. (At a point I was about to agree to pay to get rid of them using a credit card although they did not even have a credit card reader which was a sign of fraud.)

Good hotel off the beaten track in the Dolomites to explore neighboring mountains and parks. Rooftop pool was perfect for the sunset. Rooms are a good size, breakfast was decent, the service was excellent.
Rooms do get really warm in summer and AC is limited. Information about the region could be more detailed. Asked for tips with the weather forecast and reception staff was not very knowledgeable.

CLean and spacious room, free parking, great breakfast. Already came there and will come back
Nothing

Super close to the beach and all the restaurants. Huge patio with a great view. The host left fruits and beverages for us.  The electric blinds allowed us to sleep later as we enjoyed the late lively nights.

It was a great place!

Excellent location.
Apartment has musty odor. Smelly washroom. Bring toilet paper. Very noisy air conditioner. Humid bedsheets. Clogged shower drain.

The view is the best part of this property. While we didn't have a private balcony, our room was at the farthest end from the restaurant terrace, so we were able to sit outside with relative privacy. Among the staff, Lorena (the owner) was particularly welcoming and kind. In the morning, she would give activity suggestions and can set you up with discounted Cinque Terre passes. Her presence was a huge positive factor for my overall mixed review.  The complimentary cake and tea/coffee served in the morning was nice and a peaceful setting. Proximity to train station made traveling between towns very convenient. An added note, the climb up to the property is completely fine for anyone with average fitness levels. We had carry on suitcases and did not struggle.
The room size and nearby train station noise really detracts from the experience. It's hard to relax in your room as there's only room for 1 bed and nothing else. Your ability to tolerate the train noise will also depend on each person - I live in a city near subways/public transportation and found the regular train noise not too jarring, however any of the high speed trains coming through were very noticeable. Additionally, the thin curtains let in too much light in the mornings. 

Bathrooms were average, but some details were overlooked - for example, a cleaning bottle was left hanging on the towel hook upon check in and shower grout was in need of a deep clean. The water pressure was, unfortunately, non existent. 

Lastly, I really struggled with the communication with Sara, who manages the whatsapp communications (needed for checking in). I had an unauthorized charge on my credit card from the property months before check in that was outside of the rate fee. I tried to follow up multiple times to resolve the issue, but was largely ignored. Trying to resolve it in person was also to no avail. Ultimately, I had to let my bank handle it after my trip ended as I didn't want to risk my reservation being impacted before arrival. The lack of professionalism in this case ended up casting a negative shadow across the whole experience, therefore I can't recommend staying.

The location was great, close to the Roma Termini, within walking distance of most of the main attractions and many good restaurants and amenities nearby.
The noise. The booking description stated that is was close to the rail station (Roma Termini ?) and you could experience some rail noise. Looking on Google Maps this was correct, we decided that we could put up with some noise from the trains in exchange for the excellent location. What it didn't clarify is that the reference is to 2 tram lines which run directly under your windows on 2 sides of the room. The trams run every 5 to 10 minutes from 05:30 to 24:00 and are very noisy. it made it necessary to sleep with earplugs which are not very comfortable. The last suggestion would be to mount the shower head on the wall which will make it much easier to shower without having water spraying outside the tub and on the floor.

Most modern, comfortable, and stylish place I've ever stayed in. Location is supreme and the staff are wonderful. Don't think about it ..just book it here you won't be sorry you did
Nothing all great

The bed was extremely comfortable
Air conditioning

The place is great, beautifully designed and very clean. Check in and out process digital and seamless. There were no issues. We found the place to be a little tight for 4 people, but perfectly manageable.

Property was in a perfect location which was central near Rialto bridge. Staff (Mark) were extremely helpful with messages prior to arrival and help with organising excursions. Coffee machine was also great with unlimited pods available!
The property does not have much to not like - if anything I would say the check in should be made a little clearer as we did not check our booking.com messages prior to arrival.

Perfect location, close to everything and quiet. The view was incredible: the window faces a little valley with lots of trees and birds. You can see far into the Tuscan countryside and in the morning, you wake up with the songs of birds. The breakfast is great with lots of options. The room was spacious, clean with lots of storage space. The bathroom is also big with a large shower, which is a rare thing in Italy. The B&B is located on the first floor, so we had very few stairs to climb. The interior is also gorgeous with lots of vintage furniture. The owner, Duccio, is exceptionally kind and generous. He was very helpful on the day of our departure. We stayed 4 nights but we wished we had stayed longer. If we ever come back to Siena, we will definitely come here again.

Everything. Yes I mean that. The hotel was amazing. Located a short walk from the train and via stations so relatively easy to walk to with your luggage. There is a gondola station right out front and two fantastic restaurants a 5 minute walk away. The hotel staff were beyond helpful, with suggestions on just about everything to do. The breakfast was well prepared with lots of choices.
Nothing. It was truly a perfect stay.

Breakfast was very good with a wide range of choices. Fresh oranges provided to allow guests to squeeze FRESH juice - excellent.
Overall, good value for location in the heart of Rome. Room was clean but furnishings are dated. Shower was too small and TV was small with poor sound.

Room was very clean and perfect for our use. 3 people slept very comfortably. Air conditioned, full private bathroom, and separate entrance. Great instructions for entry and instructuons for local luggage storage which we used.

We spent a month in Italy, beginning and ending in Venice. Of course, if you are visiting Venice you should stay in the historical heart of it, which we did at the beginning of our trip. However, for our last 2 nights in Italy, we stayed at Ca Tessera because our flight home was due to leave at 6:00 am, meaning we would have to get to the airport by about 3:30 AM. So instead of staying in Venice for our last 2 nights, we decided to stay out near the airport which was a VERY GOOD decision. This hotel was excellent for this purpose! The facilities were great, it was quiet, very friendly staff and it was quite picturesque too. And I think they know that most people who stay here do so because they have to get to the airport (there are several hotels in the area). So they have an excellent shuttle service that will get you to and from the airport any time (book it the day before at the front desk), only 10-15 minutes away. And they had some breakfast items ready that early too. Also, because we did have 1 full day left in Italy, we wanted to go into Venice. It was VERY easy to catch a nearby bus that zoomed right to Venice, and it was easy and quick to get back to the hotel. Not complicated. And the staff can tell you how to do it easily. So if you are flying out of Venice airport and want to stay only a 10 minute shuttle ride away, this is a very good choice!
Might have been nice to have drinks available to purchase on site, since they do have a very nice lounge and outdoor sitting space.

Beautiful, well located place with lots of room. Highly recommended
One of the beds was a little uncomfortable, the one in the spare room off of kitchen.

The location was very good, just outside of the walls of the city, which meant about a 15-minute walk into the city itself (or 10 if you just want to stroll along the wall).  The staff were also very friendly and helpful.  Rooms were clean and quiet. The spa was amazing and inexpensive.
Nothing not to like here.

Andrea, our host, was amazing.  Super friendly and very helpful in ensuring we had a relaxing and enjoyable stay.  He contacted car rental company to ensure our vehicle was ready and provided much-appreciated assistance in mapping our route to our destination.  Breakfast was good, pastries, jams, cold-cuts, and very inexpensive (7 euros each). Room was clean and rustic, with wooden beams and many charming nick-nacks. View from room and from balcony was spectacular, beautiful mountains surrounding town and majestic snow-capped mountains in the far distance.  Pastoral landscape was very peaceful and nostalgic.
Would have enjoyed eggs, bacon and sausage for breakfast.  Room was a little warm for sleeping even with oscillating fan due to lack of a/c. Did not find taxi from train station so had to lug suitcases a few hundred meters to the facility, over cobblestone roadways so was tiring and a little frustrating.

Staff were friendly and helpful.   Breakfast was standard Italian breakfast with croissant and coffee.   Juice and yogurt were also offered.  Lovely little garden on the property.  Parking in the property lot was a bonus.
Our room was close to reception and it was a little noisy with people talking.    Also heard noise from patrons at the pub below.  Room decore needed a little update.
The size of the shower was quite small.
Breakfast was great, the staff were very friendly and the hotel is in a great location.

Perfect location for our short stay in Trieste, right at the edge of the old town and with close access to public parking. Plenty of space for our family of four. Happy with my choice !
Nothing to think of…

Very Clean
36 stairs up and 4 different access doors! (Definitely not explained well that the rooms are All/ONLY on the top floor).
The place has really "cute" decorating (everything matches) yet very awkward to live in and not functional for people who travel (we need flat surfaces to put our stuff on: the only super small shelf in the bathroom can fit a toothpaste, brush + the provided plastic cup and soap (need a proper sized shelf/vanity/something flat and waterproof near the sink); the narrow table for coffee/tea/cups is way too narrow to add anything else (the 'nespresso machine has to be on an angle); only small/short stool (nowhere to lay down clothes or for a grown man to sit properly). The bed is really where you have to sit and ideally not just 3 fat/ puffy bed pillows (both of us got a sore neck).
The " cute" black bar fridge compressor turns on/off loudly (irritating to sleep with)  and as others have indicated, the bathroom fan noise level which goes on with the light can 'wake the dead'.
No glasses - only 2 coffee cups/saucers and very small paper cups (horrible to drink wine/beer from:)

There are 2 small nightstands - small again - as is the area to hang clothes (the hangars have to go on an angle to fit).

So all in all, it is an awkward space to stay in even with small travel bags (they of course end up on the floor)- at one point I used the toilet lid and bidet for holding my coffee!
Oh, 6+ coffee pods yet 3 fake creamers for 2 nights:(

Even if the owner got 2 folding luggage racks, that would assist in staying organized. Yes, the shower is normal-Italy size yet tough for a real-sized person to have a good shower. (BTW  run both the shower heads before you get in to warm the water in all the pipes).

The fact that the owner insists on a 2 night MIN stay meant we were committed or lost money.

The view from the room was everything!!! 
So close to bus to city center. Elevator which was sooooo necessary with bags in 30 degree heat. Also great AC. 
Very nice host who met us and gave the keys. Awesome stay.

For travelling with a car, it was nice to find a rental that included parking that was not on the street. The location was a 20 minute walk to the Centro Storico location of the town. The area of the rental was in middle of some very good restaurants, gelato bars and pizzerias. You had everything you would need outside your door. The apartment has a common area for breakfast and lounging area with lots of tourist information at hand. Check in and communication with the host was seamless.
Beds could have been a bit more comfortable but everybody has there own comfort level.
Just a little far out from the centro Lecce, but we just walked, if your jumped on a bus it would be a very quick trip.

The staff went above and beyond. They were so welcoming and accommodating. They really wanted our stay to be special. The food was incredible, the best we’ve had in Italy to date. Over all a 11/10 experience!
Good accommodation, Renzo is very nice and helpful. Very central!
Located in a great area. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Valet parking was very easy. Breakfast was excellent

Apartment as advertised and very clean. Steps away from the bus lines into to the city center or enjoy a walk in by the river. Comfy bed and host was very responsive to any questions. Would stay there again.

The food of the restaurant is amazing and the staff really kind !
If you spent the night there, it's really loud.. the restaurant is right underneath the bedrooms and you can also hear people's from other rooms as they are really close..
Such a cute place and the staff are lovely.

Spectacular view, right in the middle of amazing cities, but the location itself is more quiet with the option to quickly travel by bus or taxi to a more popular area such as amalfi coast or positano. Also fantastic staff!
LOTS OF STAIRS

Our spacious room featured a gorgeous terrace with a view of Stromboli in the distance. We ordered an excellent, reasonably priced wine from downstairs and enjoyed a spectacular sunset.

The restaurant downstairs was family friendly, offered great value, and featured a large team of staff. While we enjoyed the pasta, the wood oven pizza looked wonderful, too.

Overall, this was our favourite accommodation during our week in Calabria.
The area is more like a collection of hotels and restaurants than a true neighbourhood. Even so, it felt safe to walk the streets at night. The pristine Spiaggia di Grotticelle is only 20 minutes away by foot, albeit down a big hill. You can skip leg day after walking back up.
Excellent host, excellent location

I didn't get her name, but the female running the hotel was awesome, so personable, provided recommendations for restaurants, allowed us to check-in early and also check-out late.  The room was exactly as described.  The location was awesome, very central, easily walk to all locations in Rome and lots of restaurants around the area.  The breakfast was also fantastic, a variety of croissants, the coffee was high quality and provided options like latte's, cappuccino or espresso, toast with cold cuts and cheese, a couple varieties of cakes, hardboiled eggs and even yogurt.  It was great!!!
The only one thing, which wasn't a big deal, is the shower head needed to be cleaned or replaced, it didn't have very good water flow, many of the holes were plugged up.  However, the hand-held wand had great water flow and pressure.

We loved how clean and nice it was all day round, showed great effort from our host Rakib to welcome us to our trip.

very spacious and great location.  Host was very helpful in getting us taxis for the whole stay and even after.

I would have loved if we could have had a larger breakfast onsite at the hotel. We were able to eat a continental breakfast in our room but it would have been really lovely to have had a separate breakfast spot on site.

I liked everything about the property.  Easy to locate and it was spotless and central to everyplace where I wanted to go.
I liked everything about the property.

I loved this hotel, it was away in the mountains. The view over the city was breathtaking, and breakfast amazed me.

The breakfast was wonderful and the rooms were super clean. The air conditioning was excellent and we had a fantastic comfortable stay and wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.
I wish that the rooms were a little larger so that more family members could have shared a room.

They were amazing and the communication was exceptional.  We were running late,  as is usual for Italian train service,  and with a quick email and text thru booking, they let us know that they would wait for us at the office! Nice,  clean,  great value,  and amazing breakfast!

The only thing to consider if you are staying for a couple of nights is the room is quite small. We stayed one night so we didnt mind but for 3 people in one room it was tiny (especially since we did pay a lot)

I don’t usually write reviews — but felt this was important to share.  It's only fair to help others get a better sense of what they're paying for.   We’re a family of four (traveling with two children under 12),

Location:  In the Navigli district — great for nightlife and canal-side restaurants. However, if your interests are visiting Milan’s main sights (Duomo, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Sforzesco Castle, or the main shopping area), staying closer to the city center is more practical.  The metro is approximately 20-minute walk away. While the tram is nearby, it wasn’t very convenient due to ongoing construction and street closures.

The Unit (2-Bedroom Loft):
The unit has A/C, but it’s placed too low to cool the loft area where the beds are. As heat rises, sleeping upstairs was uncomfortably hot and stuffy.  A fan was placed in 1 bedroom but wasn't much help. 
The furnishings and bedding are all IKEA. Sheets were rough, and the only blanket provided was a thick wool-blend — far too heavy for July.

Comfort & Amenities: 
All pillows were firm foam — not ideal for long stays or for those who prefer softer options. A mix would be appreciated.
No hooks anywhere — Nowhere to hang your purse, sweater, or towels.
Bathroom amenities--hand soap made available but seemed like shampoo/body wash was left from a previous guest.  
No tissues or Kleenex provided.
Kitchen was stocked with basic cookware, plates, and utensils, but lacked a microwave and dishwasher. Even for simple reheats, you need to use the stove.

It was quiet —However, the overall vibe inside the unit could feel a bit eerie at times, especially with kids; something to keep in mind. 

Overall:
This place has potential, but needs improvement in comfort, layout and attention to detail. For now, rating it a 3 out of 5.

On June 27, 2025, I checked into Le Terrazze Suites in Bari, Italy. Upon arriving in the afternoon, I discovered that the air conditioning in the room was malfunctioning. Although it was set to 15°C, the room temperature remained close to 30°C, and the air being circulated was hot. This extreme heat made it very difficult for my family and me to rest properly—we were sweating all night and could barely sleep.

I immediately reported the issue to Le Terrazze Suites via WhatsApp. They initially claimed that the system had “crashed” because we had turned the panel on and off multiple times (which we did not do). They attempted a remote reset, but the temperature did not drop. They promised that a technician would be sent the following day to investigate and offered to move us to another room if the problem couldn’t be resolved.

In the early morning of June 28, I provided photo evidence showing that the temperature was still between 28°C and 29.8°C. I formally requested action based on Articles 1575 and 1578 of the Italian Civil Code, which guarantee guests a safe and comfortable accommodation environment. I asked Le Terrazze Suites to either:
	•	Urgently fix or replace the air conditioning or offer another room;
	•	Or provide a partial refund or discount due to the substandard service.

Le Terrazze Suites did offer an alternative room, but it was only half the size of the original room and far too cramped to meet our needs, so I declined.

As Le Terrazze Suites failed to provide an acceptable level of comfort during our stay, I explicitly requested a partial refund on the second day. They agreed to refund 50% as compensation, but I have not received it to this day. Booking.com informed me that the property does not respond to calls or messages. The host has since deleted me from WhatsApp, but I have kept all photos, videos, and call records as proof.
